title: The Pleasure Liner Repo
logline: A defaulted luxury starliner flees across three star systems under a fabricated quarantine, hunted by an aggressive repo agent and desperate for black-market reactor coolant.

roles.description: A relentless asset recovery agent pursuing defaulted commercial vessels across jump corridors.
Veteran master of the luxury liner; vain, desperate, willing to fake a plague to keep his command.
An influential passenger in the penthouse cabins; spoiled, terrified, secretly bankrolling the ship.
A grand three-deck passenger liner with gold-leaf hull accents and failing cooling radiators.
A bustling jump-gate staging platform in the origin system crowded with refueling haulers.
An isolated, lightly regulated dock in a neighbouring border system known for discreet repairs.

public_situation: A multi-system search is underway across {system} as port authorities attempt to locate an overdue luxury liner carrying hundreds of holidaymakers.
private_truth: {role:liner_commodore} defaulted on vessel bond payments and faked a fatal biohazard quarantine aboard {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} to slip past {role:repo_factor}'s dock liens.

beats.public_change: Port authorities at the transit gate post an urgent tracking bounty for the missing luxury liner.

missions.reason: The repo factor hires the pilot to scan gate sensor buffers to determine which jump corridor the defaulted luxury liner entered.
missions.private_fact: The factor holds a private bounty clause that pays double if the ship is secured before the fiscal quarter expires.

beats.public_change: Commercial comms in the border system report an unidentifiable liner idling outside normal approach vectors.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to rush an official maritime lien warrant to the border stationmaster to freeze fuel lines to the approaching yacht.
missions.private_fact: He knows the commodore has bribed border dock personnel with luxury cruise vouchers to secure emergency propellant.

beats.public_change: The liner drops anchor in open space, emitting automated quarantine warnings while requesting coolant supplies.

missions.reason: The commodore hires the pilot to purchase emergency thermal coolant couplings from local suppliers and deliver them to his drop pod.
missions.private_fact: The ship's ballroom air conditioning has failed, and angry passengers are threatening to smash the bridge doors.

missions.reason: The factor contracts the pilot to pick up the liner's impounded navigation authorization slate from the station customs vault.
missions.private_fact: He promised customs officials a percentage of the recovered scrap value to ensure the authorization slate was seized.

beats.public_change: A coded distress transmission from {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} penetrates the dark corridor.

missions.reason: The socialite pays the pilot to scan the yacht's life support exhaust to verify whether the quarantine is genuine or manufactured.
missions.private_fact: The commodore forged the medical alert codes to prevent passengers from disembarking and revealing their location.

player_choice.prompt: The quarantine is proven fake. The socialite wants to buy the yacht, the factor wants to seize it, and the passengers want payback.

options.label: Help the socialite wire funds to clear the vessel's debt
Leak proof of the fake quarantine directly to the passengers
Assist the repo factor in disabling the flagship

beats.public_change: {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} makes a break for the ungoverned outer rim gate under sputtering ion drives.

missions.reason: The factor hires the pilot to disable the yacht's jump drive before it can cross into an unpoliced border system.
missions.private_fact: The commodore offers to forge salvage transfer manifests so the factor and pilot can strip the ship's gold fittings.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the yacht's drive, allowing the repo factor to impound the vessel.
resolutions.summary: {role:repo_factor} impounds {role:luxury_flagship_yacht}. The passengers are disembarked at a freight terminal, and {role:liner_commodore} is arrested.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a repo man chase down and disable a runaway luxury liner across three systems.

resolutions.reached_by: The socialite wires trust fund capital to clear the ship's mortgage note.
resolutions.summary: {role:cruise_socialite} pays off the defaulted bond. {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} is converted into a private estate, leaving {role:repo_factor} empty-handed.

resolutions.reached_by: The passengers learn of the fake quarantine and take command of the vessel.
resolutions.summary: Mutinous passengers lock {role:liner_commodore} in his quarters, navigate {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} to a union dock, and file mass compensation claims.

consequences.public_summary: Stranded holidaymakers locked an indebted commodore in his stateroom and flew his starliner home.

resolutions.reached_by: The factor and commodore cut a secret deal to scrap the vessel and split the payout.
resolutions.summary: {role:repo_factor} and {role:liner_commodore} report {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} destroyed, quietly selling its gold-leaf plating to border dismantlers.

consequences.public_summary: A repo agent and a captain split the salvage cash after writing off a grand yacht as orbital debris.

resolutions.reached_by: The trail goes cold, or the pilot avoids taking contracts.
resolutions.summary: {role:luxury_flagship_yacht} slips across the outer frontier boundary. Creditors write off the defaulted bonds, and {role:repo_factor} abandons the hunt.

loose_threads.detail: The liner's onboard casino vault holds millions in bearer certificates registered to a foreign mining trust.
A regional bond market logged heavy short positions against the liner's operating firm days before the default.
The recovery warrant on the yacht was reassigned through four shell corporations in forty-eight hours.

radio_hooks: Flagship pleasure liner fails to report at scheduled gate checkpoint in {system}.
Maritime repo factors offer substantial finder fees for sightings of overdue luxury craft.
Border systems report unusual surge in distress pings along unpatrolled transit lanes.

voice_direction.repo_factor: Aggressive, staccato, relentless energy. Treats multi-system ship hunts like delinquent credit card calls and quotes contract paragraphs without pausing.
voice_direction.liner_commodore: Pompous, theatrical, and steeped in unearned dignity. Covers mounting panic with aristocratic bluster about maritime traditions.
voice_direction.cruise_socialite: Petulant, entitled, and wildly out of touch with frontier realities. Assumes every problem in space can be resolved by demanding someone's superior.
